title: Бытие 16 — Genesis 16
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: Сара, ___ Авраама, не рожала ему детей.
cases.translation: Sarai, Abram's wife, bore him no children.
cases.explain: Жена stands in apposition to the subject Сара, so it stays nominative → жена.

cases.sentence: У нее была служанка из ___ по имени Агарь.
cases.translation: She had a servant from Egypt named Hagar.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from / out of) takes the genitive → Египта.
The preposition с (with) takes the instrumental → Сарой.

cases.sentence: Узнав, что беременна, Агарь начала презирать свою ___.
cases.translation: When she knew she was pregnant, Hagar began to despise her mistress.
cases.explain: Direct object of презирать (to despise) → accusative; feminine -а becomes -у.

cases.sentence: Ангел Господень нашел Агарь в ___, неподалеку от источника.
cases.translation: The angel of the Lord found Hagar in the wilderness, near a spring.
cases.explain: В marking a location (no motion) takes the prepositional → пустыне.

cases.sentence: Ангел Господень нашел Агарь неподалеку от ___.
cases.translation: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring.
cases.explain: The preposition от (near / from) takes the genitive → источника.

cases.sentence: Этот источник был рядом с дорогой к ___.
cases.translation: This spring was beside the road to Shur.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to / toward) takes the dative → Шуру.

cases.translation: You are now pregnant and will bear a son.
cases.explain: Direct object of родишь (will bear); for animate masculine nouns the accusative equals the genitive → сына.

reading.ru: Сара, жена Авраама, не рожала ему детей.
reading.question: What was the situation with Sarai, Abram's wife?
options: She had borne him no children
reading.correct: She had borne him no children
reading.explain: The chapter opens by noting that Sarai bore Abram no children.

reading.ru: У нее была служанка из Египта по имени Агарь.
reading.question: Who was Sarai's servant?
reading.explain: Sarai had an Egyptian servant named Hagar.

reading.ru: Узнав, что беременна, Агарь начала презирать свою госпожу.
reading.question: How did Hagar behave toward Sarai after she conceived?
options: She began to despise her mistress
reading.correct: She began to despise her mistress
reading.explain: Once Hagar knew she was pregnant, she began to look down on Sarai.

reading.ru: Ангел Господень нашел Агарь в пустыне, неподалеку от источника.
reading.question: Where did the angel of the Lord find Hagar?
options: In the wilderness by a spring
On the road to Egypt's border
reading.correct: In the wilderness by a spring
reading.explain: The angel found Hagar in the desert near a spring of water.

reading.ru: Тогда ангел Господень сказал ей, «Возвратись к своей госпоже и покорись ей».
reading.question: What did the angel tell Hagar to do?
options: Return to her mistress and submit to her
reading.correct: Return to her mistress and submit to her
reading.explain: The angel told Hagar to go back to Sarai and submit to her.

reading.ru: Аврааму было восемьдесят шесть лет, когда Агарь родила ему Измаила.
reading.question: How old was Abram when Ishmael was born?
reading.explain: The text states Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael.
